doc.title: Longineu Parsons interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 17, 2026

title: Advice to students about making a living
summary: He tells his music industry students only to do it if they love it enough to give everything.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: On a practical level, what do you tell your students about making a living in music?

Well see there are various ways to make a living because we have a music industry program and so they are learning business and they’re learning marketing in all the business classes, you know they’re learning accounting, they’re learning public relations. So the only thing that I really have to tell them about the business is only do this if you love it enough to give everything you have to it. Other than that, don’t mess with it.
